distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) record Shaanxi and Sichuan; Smith et al. (2020) confirms those provinces and adds Shanxi. Beaver & Liu (2010) separately treats the historical Taiwan record under Xyleborus seriatus as doubtful. Taiwan is retained as Questionable and is not included in the current distribution summary.

host_note: Current mainland hosts remain Pinus armandii, Pinus tabulaeformis, Castanopsis sp., Quercus sp. and Schima sp. Beaver & Liu (2010) contributes no host evidence for the doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Heteroborips seriatus (Blandford, 1894).
